candidateQuestions.answerEn: Let’s not meet trouble halfway by imagining that the party will fail before we have sent the invitations.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 邀請函尚未發出，我們不要便想像派對會失敗，令自己白白擔心。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Nora says the project will fail because one team member was ten minutes late.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 諾拉認為項目會失敗，原因只是一名隊員遲到了十分鐘。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Nora is meeting trouble halfway by treating one late arrival as proof that the project will fail.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 諾拉把一名隊員遲到當成項目必定失敗的證明，實在是杞人憂天。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Ella expects every small noise in the car to mean a costly repair, although the mechanic has not checked it.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 技工尚未檢查汽車，但艾拉認為每一下細小聲響都代表需要進行昂貴維修。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Instead of meeting trouble halfway by assuming that the car needs a costly repair, Ella should wait for the mechanic’s check.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 艾拉不應在技工檢查前便認定汽車需要昂貴維修，而應先等待檢查結果。

dossiers.meaningEn: To react very angrily by making a loud protest, causing a commotion or creating a noisy scene because of a problem, decision or unfair situation.
dossiers.meaningZh: 因某個問題、決定或不公平情況而非常憤怒，並大聲抗議、大吵大鬧或引起騷動。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Raise the devil is informal, vivid and forceful. It may be used in conversation, storytelling, informal reporting and descriptions of angry disputes. Dictionaries generally mark it as informal and associate it with noisy disturbance or strong protest.
dossiers.registerContextZh: Raise the devil 屬於非正式、形象化而且語氣強烈的表達。 它可以用於日常對話、故事、非正式報道，以及描述憤怒爭執的情境。
dossiers.memoryEn: Imagine that an angry protest brings so much noise and disorder into the room that chaos appears to have been released.
dossiers.memoryZh: 想像一場憤怒抗議為現場帶來極大噪音和混亂，就像把混亂力量釋放出來一樣。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Reaction Must Be Strong
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三：反應必須十分強烈
semanticRules.en: Raise the devil normally describes a loud, angry or disruptive reaction, not a polite or minor complaint.
semanticRules.zh: raise the devil 通常描述大聲、憤怒或造成騷動的反應，而不是禮貌或輕微的投訴。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for a Calm Complaint
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：不可用於冷靜投訴
semanticRules.en: The reaction is too calm to license the idiom.
semanticRules.zh: 顧客只是有禮貌地查詢價格，反應不夠強烈，因此不適合使用這個慣用語。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use the Literal Supernatural Meaning in This Exercise
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：本練習不使用召喚魔鬼的字面意思
semanticRules.en: This refers to summoning a supernatural being and is not the meaning taught in this exercise.
semanticRules.zh: 這句表示召喚超自然存在，並不是本練習教授的意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use the American Celebration Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：本練習不使用美式英語中的狂歡意思
semanticRules.en: In some American sources, raise the devil can refer to making noise while celebrating or having a wild time. That sense is excluded from this controlled exercise. Every answer must describe an angry protest or commotion.
semanticRules.zh: 在部分美式英語資料中，raise the devil 可以指喧鬧地狂歡。 本練習不教授這個意思。 所有答案都必須表示憤怒抗議或大吵大鬧。

semanticRules.titleEn: Related Expressions Are Not the Target
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：相關表達並不是本練習的目標
semanticRules.en: These may express related ideas, but every answer in this exercise must use raise the devil.
semanticRules.zh: 以上表達的意思可能相近，但本練習的所有答案都必須使用 raise the devil。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The passengers complained loudly and angrily when the last train was cancelled.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 尾班車被取消時，乘客大聲而憤怒地投訴。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The passengers raised the devil when the last train was cancelled.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 尾班車被取消時，乘客大吵大鬧。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Have the neighbours made a noisy protest about the new car park? B: Yes, they have.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：鄰居有沒有就新停車場大聲抗議？ 乙：有。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Yes, the neighbours have raised the devil about the new car park.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 有，鄰居已就新停車場大吵大鬧。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: “My father will become extremely angry and make a scene when he sees this repair bill,” Isla said.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 「我爸爸看到這張維修帳單時，一定會非常憤怒，並大吵大鬧，」艾拉說。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Isla said that her father would raise the devil when he saw the repair bill.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 艾拉說，她爸爸看到維修帳單時一定會大發雷霆。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Why was Chloe shouting at the hotel desk? Her room had not been cleaned.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 為甚麼克洛伊在酒店櫃檯大聲叫喊？她的房間尚未清潔。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Chloe raised the devil at the hotel desk because her room had not been cleaned.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 克洛伊因房間尚未清潔，在酒店櫃檯大發雷霆。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: The bank says it may take six weeks to return money it took by mistake. B: Six weeks? Customers will not accept that quietly.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：銀行表示，可能需要六星期才退回誤扣的款項。 乙：六星期？顧客不會安靜地接受這個安排。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Customers will raise the devil if the bank takes six weeks to return money it took by mistake.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 如果銀行要用六星期才退回誤扣的款項，顧客便會大發雷霆。

dossiers.meaningEn: To annoy, irritate or upset someone, especially repeatedly or in a way that is difficult for that person to ignore.
dossiers.meaningZh: 令某人感到煩躁、惱火或心煩，尤其指某種言行反覆出現，令人難以忽視。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversations; messages between friends or colleagues; interviews; personal stories; general workplace discussion; informal articles and commentary.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬於非正式至中性語域，常見於日常對話、朋友或同事之間的訊息、訪問、個人敘述及一般工作討論。
dossiers.memoryEn: Something irritating under the skin is hard to ignore; an irritating person or habit can feel equally difficult to ignore.
dossiers.memoryZh: 皮膚下的刺激難以忽視；一個惱人的人或習慣也可能同樣令人無法不去介意。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Omit “Get”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則一：不可省略 get
semanticRules.en: The expression needs an appropriately inflected form of get.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語必須配合適當形式的 get。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It for Genuine Irritation
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：只用於真正令人煩躁的情況
semanticRules.en: The source must support a noticeable emotional reaction.
semanticRules.zh: 原句必須真正支持明顯的煩躁或惱火情緒。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Serious Medical Conditions
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要用於嚴重醫療情況
semanticRules.en: The expression is too informal and too weak for describing serious illness, injury or medical danger.
semanticRules.zh: 這個表達不適合用來描述嚴重疾病、受傷或醫療危險。

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid Accidental Literal Meanings
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：避免意外使用字面意思
semanticRules.en: Literal: Idiomatic: Only the second sentence uses the target idiom.
semanticRules.zh: 醫生把藥物注入病人的皮下。 病人反覆投訴，令護士感到煩躁。 只有第二句使用了本課教授的慣用語。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The tapping continues all day, and it annoys me.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 敲擊聲整天不停，令我很煩躁。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The constant tapping gets under my skin.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 持續的敲擊聲令我十分煩躁。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: He made that comment only because he wanted to annoy me.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 他說那句話，只是因為他想惹惱我。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: He was only trying to get under my skin with that comment.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 他說那句話，只是想故意惹惱我。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The coach criticised the players again and again, and they became annoyed.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 教練反覆批評球員，令他們感到惱火。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The coach’s repeated criticism got under the players’ skin.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 教練反覆作出的批評令球員感到惱火。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The new student asks polite questions. However, asking them at the wrong time sometimes annoys the teacher.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 新同學提出的問題很有禮貌，但有時發問的時機不對，令老師感到煩躁。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The new student’s questions are polite, but their timing sometimes gets under the teacher’s skin.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 新同學提出的問題很有禮貌，但發問的時機有時會令老師感到煩躁。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Every time the printer stops working, the office staff become annoyed.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 每當打印機停止運作，辦公室職員都會感到煩躁。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Whenever the printer stops working, it gets under the office staff’s skin.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 每當打印機停止運作，辦公室職員都會感到煩躁。
candidateQuestions.highlight: gets under the office staff’s skin

dossiers.meaningEn: A person, idea, style, experience or change that is welcome because it is pleasantly new, different, lively, clear or positive compared with what came before.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一個人物、想法、風格、體驗或轉變，因為比原有情況更新鮮、更有活力、更清晰或更正面，所以令人感到耳目一新、精神一振或帶來新氣象。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversation; workplace discussion; interviews; reviews; presentations; news and magazine writing; general descriptive writing.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬於中性至較口語的用法，帶有明顯的正面評價。
dossiers.memoryEn: Fresh air refreshes a closed room; a welcome new person or idea refreshes a tired situation.
dossiers.memoryZh: 新鮮空氣令封閉房間煥然一新；令人欣喜的新人物或想法則令沉悶的情況出現新氣象。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use Breath, Not Breathe
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：使用 breath，而不是 breathe
semanticRules.en: Use Breath, Not Breathe
semanticRules.zh: 使用 breath，而不是 breathe

semanticRules.titleEn: New Does Not Automatically Mean Refreshing
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：新事物不一定令人耳目一新
semanticRules.en: The change should also feel positive, welcome or pleasantly different.
semanticRules.zh: 不要因為某件事物是新的，便自動使用這個慣用語。 語境必須顯示這個轉變令人欣喜或感覺良好。

semanticRules.titleEn: Distinguish the Idiomatic and Literal Meanings
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：分辨慣用意思及字面意思
semanticRules.en: Distinguish the Idiomatic and Literal Meanings
semanticRules.zh: 我到外面呼吸一下新鮮空氣。 她坦白的回答令人精神一振。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with Similar Expressions
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要與相近表達混淆
semanticRules.en: Do Not Confuse It with Similar Expressions
semanticRules.zh: 不要與相近表達混淆

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十二：自然使用，不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: The expression is useful when a clear, positive contrast exists. A plain expression such as new, different, enjoyable or a welcome change may be clearer when no strong contrast is needed.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語適合用於存在明顯正面對比的情況。 如果不需要突出新舊反差，直接使用 new、 different、enjoyable 或 a welcome change 可能會更加清楚。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: For months, the lessons were dull. The new teacher’s lively style feels pleasantly different.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 過去數月，課堂十分沉悶。新老師生動的教學方式令人感到耳目一新。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The new teacher’s lively style is a breath of fresh air after months of dull lessons.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 經過數月沉悶的課堂後，新老師生動的教學方式令人耳目一新。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Television debates had been angry all week. The calm interview felt like a welcome change.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 電視辯論整個星期都充滿火藥味。這次平靜的訪問令人感到是可喜的轉變。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The calm interview was a breath of fresh air after a week of angry television debates.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 經過一星期充滿火藥味的電視辯論後，這次平靜的訪問令人精神一振。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The family was worried after several unclear conversations. The nurse then explained everything warmly and clearly.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 經過幾次不清楚的對話後，這家人十分擔心。護士其後親切而清楚地解釋一切。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The nurse’s warm explanation was a breath of fresh air for the worried family.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 護士親切的解釋令憂心的家人精神一振。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Yesterday’s tour was rushed and tiring. Was today’s guide any better? B: Yes. He was relaxed and gave us time to enjoy each place.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：昨天的行程又趕又累。今天的導遊有好一點嗎？ 乙：有。他很從容，也讓我們有時間欣賞每個地方。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Yes, our guide’s relaxed style was a breath of fresh air after yesterday’s rushed tour.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 有。經過昨天匆忙的行程後，今天導遊從容的帶領方式令人耳目一新。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The room was formal and quiet, but Leo’s friendly introduction made everyone feel more relaxed.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 房間裡的氣氛正式而安靜，但里奧友善的介紹令大家放鬆了一些。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Although the room was formal and quiet, Leo’s friendly introduction was a breath of fresh air.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 雖然房間裡的氣氛正式而安靜，但里奧友善的介紹令人精神一振。

dossiers.lemma: in the blink of an eye
dossiers.sourcePdf: Idiom 56 - “In the Blink of an Eye”.pdf
dossiers.meaningEn: Extremely quickly, or within such a short time that the action or change seems almost immediate.
dossiers.meaningZh: 某件事發生得極快，快得彷彿眨一次眼便已經完成、消失或發生改變。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Teaching classification: neutral and expressive.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 教學語域分類：中性而帶有一定表達力。
dossiers.fixed: in the blink of an eye
surfaceForms: in the blink of an eye
In the blink of an eye
dossiers.memoryEn: Before you have time to blink, it is already done.
dossiers.memoryZh: 你還未來得及眨眼，事情便已經完成。

semanticRules.titleEn: It Expresses a Strong Degree of Speed
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：它表示非常快的速度
semanticRules.en: The idiom is stronger than simply saying quickly. Soon does not necessarily mean almost immediately.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語的程度比一般的 quickly 更強。 並不一定表示事情在一瞬間發生。

semanticRules.titleEn: Distinguish Literal and Idiomatic Meanings
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：分辨字面意思及慣用意思
semanticRules.en: She blinked her eyes. The exercise always tests the idiomatic meaning.
semanticRules.zh: 她眨了眨眼。 她一眨眼便消失了。 本練習只測試比喻用法。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：自然使用，不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: The idiom is useful when extreme speed, suddenness or lack of reaction time is important. A plain word such as quickly or immediately may be clearer in ordinary factual sentences.
semanticRules.zh: 只有當極快速度、突然性或沒有時間反應是重要意思時，才適合使用這個慣用語。 在普通的事實陳述中，quickly 或 immediately 有時會更清楚。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The bird flew away so quickly that I hardly saw it leave.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 小鳥飛走得非常快，我幾乎看不見牠離開。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The bird flew away in the blink of an eye.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 小鳥一眨眼便飛走了。
candidateQuestions.highlight: in the blink of an eye

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The school bell rang, and children rushed into the empty playground almost immediately.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 學校鐘聲一響，孩子們便幾乎立即衝進原本空蕩蕩的遊樂場。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: In the blink of an eye, the empty playground filled with children after the school bell rang.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 學校鐘聲響起後，原本空蕩蕩的遊樂場一眨眼便擠滿孩子。
candidateQuestions.highlight: In the blink of an eye

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Did you see who took the last biscuit? B: No. It was there, and then it was suddenly gone.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：你有看到誰拿走最後一塊餅乾嗎？ 乙：沒有。它剛才還在，突然便不見了。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: No. The last biscuit disappeared in the blink of an eye.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 沒有。最後一塊餅乾轉眼間便消失了。
candidateQuestions.highlight: in the blink of an eye

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The photo appeared on the screen as soon as I tapped the icon.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 我一按下圖示，相片便立即出現在畫面上。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The photo appeared on the screen in the blink of an eye after I tapped the icon.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我一按下圖示，相片便瞬間出現在畫面上。
candidateQuestions.highlight: in the blink of an eye

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: We are leaving in one minute. Are you ready? B: I only need a moment.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：我們一分鐘後便要出發。你準備好了嗎？ 乙：我只需要一會兒。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: I’ll be ready in the blink of an eye.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我一眨眼便會準備好。
candidateQuestions.highlight: in the blink of an eye

dossiers.meaningEn: To make a genuine change for the better in your behaviour, attitude or way of living, especially after having bad habits or making mistakes.
dossiers.meaningZh: 真正改善自己的行為、態度或生活方式，尤其指一個人改掉以往的壞習慣或錯誤，重新開始。
dossiers.registerContextEn: The expression is neutral to informal. It is natural in everyday conversation, personal writing, interviews, news reports and general workplace communication.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬中性至較口語，適合日常對話、個人寫作、訪問、新聞報道及一般工作溝通。
dossiers.memoryEn: Leave the old page behind; write better actions on the new one.
dossiers.memoryZh: 把舊頁留在身後，在新的一頁寫下更好的行動。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not interpret leaf as a plant leaf
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要把 leaf 理解為植物的葉子
semanticRules.en: In this idiom, leaf refers to the image of a sheet or page in a book.
semanticRules.zh: 在這個慣用語中，leaf 帶出書頁的意象，而不是植物的葉子。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not overstate weak evidence
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把微弱證據說得過於肯定
semanticRules.en: If somebody has behaved well for only one day, use cautious wording such as may be trying to turn over a new leaf.
semanticRules.zh: 如果某人只在一天內表現良好，可以使用 may be trying to turn over a new leaf 等較審慎的說法。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not use it in a literal page-turning sentence
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：不要在真正翻頁的句子中使用這個慣用語
semanticRules.en: She turned over a new leaf and began studying seriously. I ate one healthy breakfast today. This is one isolated action, not yet a lasting change. He moved to a new office, but his behaviour stayed the same. The situation changed, but he did not improve his behaviour. She turned over a leaf in her notebook. This is a literal physical action.
semanticRules.zh: 不適用的情況我今天吃了一頓健康早餐。 這只是一個單獨行動，尚未顯示持久改變。 他搬到新的辦公室，但行為沒有改變。 情況有所改變，但他並沒有改善自己的行為。 她把筆記簿的一頁翻過去。 這是字面上的實際動作。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Daniel used to arrive late for work, but he now arrives on time every day.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 丹尼爾以前經常上班遲到，但他現在每天都準時到達。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Daniel has turned over a new leaf at work and now arrives on time every day.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 丹尼爾在工作上已改過自新，現在每天都準時到達。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The manager believes Adam is serious about changing because he has not missed a shift for three months.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 經理相信亞當是認真改變，因為他三個月來沒有缺勤任何一更。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The manager believes Adam has turned over a new leaf at work because he has not missed a shift for three months.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 經理相信亞當已在工作上改過自新，因為他三個月來沒有缺勤任何一更。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Why has Priya deleted all the shopping apps? B: She wants to stop buying things she does not need.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：為甚麼佩雅刪除了所有購物應用程式？ 乙：她想停止購買不需要的東西。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Priya is trying to turn over a new leaf by deleting the shopping apps and buying only what she needs.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 佩雅正嘗試改變以往的習慣，刪除購物應用程式，只購買自己需要的東西。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Dad is surprised that I washed the dishes and cleaned the kitchen. B: Maybe he thinks you have finally changed your ways.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：爸爸很驚訝我洗了碗，還清潔了廚房。 乙：也許他認為你終於改變了以往的習慣。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Maybe he thinks you have finally turned over a new leaf at home.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 也許他認為你終於在家中改過自新了。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Since moving to the new flat, our neighbour has stopped playing loud music at night.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 搬到新單位後，我們的鄰居已停止在晚上播放大聲音樂。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Our neighbour seems to be turning over a new leaf by keeping the noise down at night.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我們的鄰居似乎正在改變以往的習慣，晚上會把聲浪降低。

dossiers.meaningEn: When a machine, device, part or system gives up the ghost, it stops working completely, often after it has become old or unreliable.
dossiers.meaningZh: 當機器、裝置、零件或系統 give up the ghost，意思是它完全停止運作，通常是因為已經老化或變得不可靠。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversation; personal messages; informal workplace conversations; stories and personal accounts; informal product comments.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬於非正式至中性語域。 用來形容機器時，通常帶有幽默或輕微誇張的語氣，適合用於日常對話、私人訊息、較輕鬆的工作交流、故事及非正式產品評論。
dossiers.memoryEn: Imagine that the machine has lost its final sign of life and can no longer work.
dossiers.memoryZh: 想像機器失去了最後一點生命跡象，從此不能再運作。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not add an object
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：不要在慣用語後加入受詞
semanticRules.en: Do not add an object
semanticRules.zh: 不要在慣用語後加入受詞

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not use it for every small problem
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：不要用來形容所有小問題
semanticRules.en: A small or temporary problem does not normally justify the idiom.
semanticRules.zh: 輕微或短暫的問題通常不足以使用這個慣用語。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not confuse it with ordinary give up
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要與普通的 give up 混淆
semanticRules.en: give up give up the ghost
semanticRules.zh: 停止嘗試； 放棄完全停止運作； 徹底壞掉

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid an accidental literal or death-related reading
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：避免意外產生死亡相關意思
semanticRules.en: This exercise uses machines, devices, parts and systems as subjects so that the intended meaning remains clear.
semanticRules.zh: 本練習以機器、裝置、零件及系統作主語，確保學生清楚理解所教授的是「完全壞掉」的意思。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The old radio no longer works at all.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 那部舊收音機已完全不能運作。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The old radio has given up the ghost.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 那部舊收音機已經完全壞掉了。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The toy robot took one last slow step and then stopped working completely.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 玩具機械人緩慢地踏出最後一步，然後完全停止運作。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The toy robot gave up the ghost after one last slow step.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 玩具機械人緩慢地踏出最後一步後，便完全壞掉了。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Is the rice ready? B: No. The rice cooker is not producing any heat.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：飯煮好了嗎？ 乙：還沒有。電飯煲完全沒有發熱。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: No. The rice cooker has given up the ghost.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 還沒有。電飯煲已經完全壞掉。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Some rooms are still cold, so the heating system seems to be slowly failing.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 部分房間仍然很冷，因此暖氣系統似乎正在逐漸失靈。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The heating system seems to be giving up the ghost because some rooms are still cold.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 由於部分房間仍然很冷，暖氣系統似乎正在逐漸壞掉。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The emergency light has a weak battery. It could stop working during a power cut unless we replace the battery soon.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 緊急照明燈的電池十分微弱。如果我們不盡快更換電池，它可能會在停電時停止運作。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Unless we replace the battery soon, the emergency light could give up the ghost during a power cut.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 除非我們盡快更換電池，否則緊急照明燈可能會在停電時完全失效。

dossiers.meaningEn: The middle and usually the coldest, darkest or harshest part of winter.
dossiers.meaningZh: 冬季的中段，通常也是最寒冷、日照最短或天氣最惡劣的時期；即「隆冬」或「嚴冬時節」。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversation; stories and personal accounts; news and feature writing; speeches and presentations; general descriptive writing.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達的語氣屬中性至生動，可以用於日常對話、故事、個人敘述、新聞特寫、演講、簡報及一般描述文章。
dossiers.memoryEn: Think of winter at its deepest, stillest and coldest point.
dossiers.memoryZh: 把冬季想像成進入最深、最寂靜和最寒冷的階段。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Every Winter Day
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三：不能用來表示冬季的任何一天
semanticRules.en: The expression has a strong meaning. It refers to the middle and generally most severe part of winter. Buying shoes has no clear connection with the severity of midwinter, so the idiom may sound unnecessarily dramatic.
semanticRules.zh: 這個表達的語意較強，表示冬季中段及通常最嚴寒的時期。 湖面在隆冬時節結冰。 我們在隆冬時節買了新鞋。 買鞋與隆冬的嚴寒沒有明顯關係，因此使用這個慣用語可能顯得過度誇張。

semanticRules.titleEn: “Dead” Is Not Literal
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四：dead 並不是字面意思
semanticRules.en: The whole phrase refers to the deepest and coldest stage of the season.
semanticRules.zh: 整個短語表示冬季最深、最寒冷的階段。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：自然使用，不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: danger; difficulty; isolation; cold; persistence; an unexpected contrast; a striking scene. A plain expression such as in winter may be better when the exact severity of the season is unimportant.
semanticRules.zh: 當隆冬的惡劣環境能夠解釋危險、困難、孤立、寒冷、堅持、意外對比或鮮明畫面時，這個表達最為自然。 如果季節的嚴寒程度並不重要，普通的 in winter 可能更自然。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: It was the middle of winter, and the lake was covered with ice.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 當時正值冬季最寒冷的時候，湖面被冰覆蓋。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: It was the dead of winter, and the lake was covered with ice.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 當時正值隆冬，湖面被冰覆蓋。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The weather was extremely cold and snowy. Even then, the school did not close.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 當時天氣極為寒冷，而且下着大雪。即使如此，學校也沒有停課。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The school did not close even in the dead of winter, despite the heavy snow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 即使正值隆冬並下着大雪，學校也沒有停課。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Heavy snow fell during the coldest weeks. Despite this, the train continued to run.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 冬季最寒冷的幾個星期下了大雪。儘管如此，火車仍然繼續行駛。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The train continued to run through the dead of winter despite the heavy snow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 儘管下着大雪，火車在整個隆冬仍然繼續行駛。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The weather is at its coldest, but the small shop still opens every day.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 天氣正值最寒冷的時候，但這間小店仍然每天營業。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The small shop stays open even in the dead of winter.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 即使在隆冬時節，這間小店仍然照常營業。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The wedding took place in the coldest part of winter, so the couple chose an indoor hall.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 婚禮在冬季最寒冷的時候舉行，所以新人選擇了室內禮堂。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Because the wedding took place in the dead of winter, the couple chose an indoor hall.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 由於婚禮在隆冬時節舉行，新人選擇了室內禮堂。

dossiers.meaningEn: the middle of the night, especially when it is very dark and quiet
dossiers.meaningZh: 深夜時分，尤其是漆黑而寂靜的夜晚。
dossiers.registerContextEn: All four words must remain in this order.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達本身並不粗俗，也不屬於俚語，但語氣比 in the middle of the night 更鮮明、更具畫面感。
dossiers.memoryEn: Imagine the night at its deepest point: almost no light, little sound and most people asleep.
dossiers.memoryZh: 想像夜晚最深沉的一刻：幾乎沒有光線、四周寂靜，大部分人都已入睡。

semanticRules.titleEn: “Dead” Does Not Mean That Someone Has Died
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三
semanticRules.en: In this expression, dead helps describe the night at its deepest, darkest or quietest point. Do not translate the expression literally as: Natural Chinese meanings include:
semanticRules.zh: 這裏的 dead 並不是指有人死亡，而是強調夜晚最深沉、最黑暗或最寂靜的時段。 死亡的夜晚深夜時分； 夜深人靜時； 萬籟俱寂之時； 夜晚最深沉的時候。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for the Early Evening
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五
semanticRules.en: We had dinner at eight in the evening.
semanticRules.zh: 一般情況下，晚上八時並不算 the dead of night。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Deep-Night Setting Must Matter
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六
semanticRules.en: Unless the unusual time is important, the vivid idiom may add nothing useful.
semanticRules.zh: 只有當「深夜發生」對事件的氣氛、驚訝程度或重要性有明顯作用時，才應使用這個表達。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The phone rang very late at night, when the whole house was dark and quiet.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 電話在深夜很晚的時候響起，當時整間屋既黑暗又安靜。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The phone rang in the dead of night.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 電話在夜深人靜時響起。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The shop alarm suddenly went off when the streets were completely empty.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 街道完全空無一人時，店舖的警報器突然響起。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The shop alarm suddenly went off in the dead of night, when the streets were completely empty.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 店舖的警報器在夜深人靜、街道空無一人時突然響起。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: We were driving through the mountains long after midnight when a deer crossed the road.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 午夜過後很久，我們駕車穿過山區時，一隻鹿橫過馬路。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: We were driving through the mountains in the dead of night when a deer crossed the road.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我們在深夜駕車穿過山區時，一隻鹿橫過馬路。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: When did Karen send that urgent message? B: She sent it when most people were fast asleep.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：Karen 何時發出那則緊急訊息？ 乙：她在大部分人都熟睡時發出的。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: She sent the urgent message in the dead of night.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 她在夜深人靜時發出那則緊急訊息。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The old sailor remembered hearing the ship’s bell during the darkest hour of the night.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 那名老水手記得自己曾在夜晚最黑暗的時候聽到船鐘聲。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The old sailor remembered hearing the ship’s bell in the dead of night.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 那名老水手記得自己曾在深夜時分聽到船鐘聲。

dossiers.meaningEn: To be extremely angry, especially when the anger is shown through fierce words, shouting or an intimidating manner.
dossiers.meaningZh: 非常憤怒；怒火中燒；大發雷霆。這個表達通常表示怒氣十分強烈，而且明顯表現在說話、語氣或行為上。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Breathe fire is informal to neutral. It is vivid, dramatic and sometimes slightly humorous or exaggerated.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個慣用語屬於非正式至中性用語，語氣鮮明而強烈，有時亦可能帶有輕微誇張或幽默效果。
dossiers.memoryEn: A dragon sends out powerful flames; an extremely angry person sends out powerful words.
dossiers.memoryZh: 巨龍噴出猛烈火焰；極度憤怒的人則說出猛烈的話。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It for Strong Anger
semanticRules.titleZh: breathe fire 表示非常強烈的怒氣，而不是輕微不滿
semanticRules.en: Breathe fire expresses intense anger, not mild annoyance. The manager shouted at everyone after discovering the serious mistake. I was a little annoyed because the bus was five minutes late.
semanticRules.zh: breathe fire 表示非常強烈的怒氣，而不是輕微不滿。 經理發現嚴重錯誤後，向所有人大叫。 巴士遲了五分鐘，我有點不滿。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use Only the Figurative Meaning in This Exercise
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二
semanticRules.en: Every answer must describe human anger. Do not use the literal meaning involving real flames.
semanticRules.zh: 本練習中的所有答案都必須表示人的怒氣，不可使用真正噴火的字面意思。 巨龍向騎士噴火。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Every Angry Person
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七
semanticRules.en: A person may be angry without breathing fire. The idiom normally suggests very strong, visible or verbally expressed anger.
semanticRules.zh: 一個人生氣並不代表一定可以使用 breathe fire。 這個慣用語通常表示非常強烈、明顯或透過言語表達的怒氣。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Mix Related Expressions
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八
semanticRules.en: Do Not Mix Related Expressions
semanticRules.zh: 規則八

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The coach was extremely angry after the players ignored his instructions.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 球員無視教練的指示後，教練非常憤怒。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The coach was breathing fire after the players ignored his instructions.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 球員無視教練的指示後，教練大發雷霆。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The manager was furious about the repeated errors, but she became calm after we corrected them.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 經理因為一再出現的錯誤而非常憤怒，但我們改正錯誤後，她便冷靜下來。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The manager was breathing fire over the repeated errors, but she calmed down after we corrected them.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 經理因為一再出現的錯誤而大發雷霆，但我們改正錯誤後，她便冷靜下來。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Did Priya merely look disappointed? B: No. She shouted and slammed her folder down.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：Priya 只是看起來有點失望嗎？ 乙：不是。她大叫，還把文件夾重重放下。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: No, Priya was breathing fire, not merely disappointed.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 不是，Priya 當時大發雷霆，並不只是失望。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The customer began speaking with intense anger when she saw the extra charge.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 顧客看到額外收費時，開始以極為憤怒的語氣說話。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The customer began to breathe fire when she saw the extra charge.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 顧客看到額外收費時，開始大發雷霆。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The chef was furiously shouting at his assistant for burning the meal.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 廚師因為助手把食物煮焦而向他憤怒地大叫。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The chef was breathing fire at his assistant for burning the meal.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 廚師因為助手把食物煮焦而向他大發雷霆。

dossiers.meaningEn: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一個看似或聲稱強大、危險、嚴厲或有效，但實際上缺乏真正實力、權力或作用的人、團體、組織、規則、威脅、制度或情況。
dossiers.registerContextEn: The expression is common in conversation, journalism, presentations and general commentary. Its tone is normally critical, disapproving or dismissive. It is not a swear word, but calling a person a paper tiger directly may sound insulting because it suggests that the person’s confidence or power is largely false. Cambridge specifically labels the expression as disapproving.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達常見於對話、新聞報道、簡報和一般評論。 語氣通常帶有批評、不認同或輕視意味。 它不是粗俗用語，但直接把一個人稱為 a paper tiger 可能帶有侮辱性，因為這暗示對方的自信或權力大部分只是表象。
dossiers.memoryEn: A real tiger has strength; a paper tiger has only the appearance of strength.
dossiers.memoryZh: 真正的老虎擁有力量；紙老虎只有強大的外表。

semanticRules.titleEn: Both Sides of the Contrast Must Be Present
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則一：必須包含對比的兩面
semanticRules.en: 1. appears powerful, frightening, strict or effective; 2. is actually weak, harmless, powerless or ineffective.
semanticRules.zh: 只有在某人或某事表面強大、可怕、嚴厲或有效，但實際上薄弱、無害、無權或無效時，才適合使用這個慣用語。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Simply to Mean “Weak”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：不要把它當作 weak 的普通同義詞
semanticRules.en: One defeat alone does not show that the team previously appeared powerful but was actually weak.
semanticRules.zh: 單純弱小或一次失敗並不足以構成 a paper tiger。 語境必須先建立強大的表象。

semanticRules.titleEn: “Not a Paper Tiger” Has the Opposite Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：not a paper tiger 表示相反意思
semanticRules.en: This means that the rule has real force and will genuinely be applied.
semanticRules.zh: 這表示規則並非只是表面強硬，而是真正具有作用並會得到執行。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Carefully About People
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：形容人物時要小心使用
semanticRules.en: Calling somebody a paper tiger suggests that their strength, confidence or authority is false or exaggerated. Use it carefully in professional or polite situations.
semanticRules.zh: 把某人稱為 a paper tiger，暗示對方的實力、自信或權威只是誇大表象。 在專業或禮貌場合應小心使用。

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid Literal Paper Animals
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：不要混淆字面上的紙老虎
semanticRules.en: Literal: Idiomatic:
semanticRules.zh: 孩子在美術課製作了一隻紙老虎。 這個看似可怕的組織其實外強中乾。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Overuse It
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: A plain word such as weak, ineffective, powerless or empty may be clearer when there is no meaningful contrast between appearance and reality.
semanticRules.zh: 如果語境沒有「表面強大、實際薄弱」的明顯對比，使用 weak、ineffective、powerless 或 empty 可能更加清楚自然。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Ryan frightens younger pupils and talks as if he is powerful. However, he backs down whenever someone answers him calmly.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: Ryan 會恐嚇年幼學生，說話時好像很有勢力；可是，每當有人冷靜回應，他便會退縮。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Ryan is a paper tiger: he frightens younger pupils but backs down when anyone answers him calmly.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: Ryan 其實只是一隻紙老虎；他會恐嚇年幼學生，但只要有人冷靜回應，他便會退縮。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The team had a famous name, so everyone expected it to be strong. Its easy defeat showed how weak it really was.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這支隊伍名氣很大，所以大家都以為它很強；它輕易落敗，顯示實際實力十分薄弱。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Its famous name hid the fact that the team was a paper tiger, as the easy defeat showed.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這支隊伍的名氣掩蓋了它外強中乾的事實，而輕易落敗正好證明了這一點。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The warning sounded serious, but nobody took any action after it was issued.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 警告聽來十分嚴重，但發出警告後，沒有人採取任何行動。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Although the warning sounded serious, it proved to be a paper tiger when no action followed.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 雖然警告聽來十分嚴重，但之後沒有任何行動，證明它只是虛張聲勢。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: The seller says he will take us to court. B: He has made the same threat before, but he has never done anything.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：賣家說要控告我們。 乙：他以前也作出過同樣威脅，但從來沒有採取任何行動。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: He has made the same empty threat before; he is probably a paper tiger.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 他以前也作出過同樣的空洞威脅；他大概只是一隻紙老虎。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: That leader speaks as if he controls the whole group. B: But the members ignore every order he gives.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：那位領袖說話時，好像能控制整個團體。 乙：但成員完全不理會他的任何命令。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: No. Without his group’s support, he will look like a paper tiger.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 不是。沒有團體成員的支持，他看來只會像一隻紙老虎。

dossiers.lemma: kill two birds with one stone
dossiers.sourcePdf: Idiom 63 - 「Kill Two Birds with One Stone」.pdf
dossiers.meaningEn: To achieve two useful goals or results through one action, plan or decision.
dossiers.meaningZh: 透過一個行動、計劃或決定，同時達成兩個有用的目標或取得兩項成果；即「一舉兩得」或「一石二鳥」。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversations; workplace discussions; meetings and presentations; general articles and informal writing; advice and suggestions.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬於中性至非正式語氣，常見於：
dossiers.fixed: kill two birds with one stone
surfaceForms: killed two birds with one stone
kills two birds with one stone
kill two birds with one stone
dossiers.memoryEn: One stone represents one action; the two birds represent the two results.
dossiers.memoryZh: 一塊石頭代表一個行動；兩隻鳥代表兩項成果。

semanticRules.titleEn: One Action Must Produce Two Results
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則一：一個行動必須帶來兩項成果
semanticRules.en: The students made a video that completed their science project and taught them how to edit. The students made a video and later bought lunch.
semanticRules.zh: 學生製作一段影片，既完成科學專題，也學會剪輯。 製作影片和購買午餐是兩項分開的行動，沒有共同的效率關係。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Two “Birds” Must Be Distinct
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：兩項成果必須有所不同
semanticRules.en: The walk allowed her to return the books and get some exercise. The walk helped her exercise and become more active.
semanticRules.zh: 步行讓她既能歸還書本，也能做運動。 兩項成果過於相似，未必足以構成清晰的「一舉兩得」。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use the Figurative Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：使用比喻意思
semanticRules.en: The hunter tried to hit two birds with one stone. The trip allowed her to attend the meeting and visit her family. Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
semanticRules.zh: 獵人嘗試用一塊石頭擊中兩隻鳥。 這次行程讓她既能出席會議，也能探望家人。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Only One Result
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：只有一項成果時不要使用
semanticRules.en: Do Not Use It for Only One Result
semanticRules.zh: 句子只提及完成家課一項成果。 在圖書館做家課，既完成工作，也歸還書本。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Add the Literal Explanation Again
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：使用慣用語後不要重複解釋相同意思
semanticRules.en: Do Not Add the Literal Explanation Again
semanticRules.zh: 慣用語本身已表達「一個行動帶來兩項成果」，毋須再次解釋。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：自然使用，不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: 1. there are two clear needs or goals; 2. one shared action deals with both; 3. the speaker wishes to emphasise efficiency.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語最適合用於兩項需要或目標能透過同一行動完成，而說話者希望強調效率的情況。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Ella walked to the supermarket. She bought the groceries and got some exercise.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: Ella 步行到超級市場。她既買了日用品，也做了運動。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Ella killed two birds with one stone by walking to the supermarket: she bought the groceries and got some exercise.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: Ella 步行到超級市場，一舉兩得：既買了日用品，也做了運動。
candidateQuestions.highlight: killed two birds with one stone

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The new bus route helps workers reach the office and reduces the number of cars on the road.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 新的巴士路線既幫助員工前往辦公室，也減少路上的汽車數量。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The new bus route kills two birds with one stone by helping workers reach the office and reducing the number of cars on the road.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 新的巴士路線一舉兩得：既幫助員工前往辦公室，也減少路上的汽車數量。
candidateQuestions.highlight: kills two birds with one stone

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: We need to check how much stock we have and tidy the storeroom. B: We can do both while we organise the shelves.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：我們需要點算存貨，也要整理儲物室。 乙：我們整理層架時便可以同時完成兩件事。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: We can kill two birds with one stone by organising the shelves: we can check the stock and tidy the storeroom.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我們可以在整理層架時一舉兩得：既點算存貨，也整理儲物室。
candidateQuestions.highlight: kill two birds with one stone

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Sam says lights that use less electricity will make the building entrance safer and reduce the power bill.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: Sam 說，較省電的燈既能令大廈入口更安全，也能減少電費。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Sam thinks the new lights will kill two birds with one stone by making the entrance safer and reducing the power bill.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: Sam 認為新燈具會一舉兩得：既令入口更安全，也減少電費。
candidateQuestions.highlight: kill two birds with one stone

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The roof window makes the room brighter and allows hot air to escape.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 屋頂窗戶既能令房間更光亮，也能讓熱空氣排出。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The roof window kills two birds with one stone by bringing more light into the room and allowing hot air to escape.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 屋頂窗戶一舉兩得：既讓更多光線進入房間，也讓熱空氣排出。
candidateQuestions.highlight: kills two birds with one stone

dossiers.meaningEn: to take a less active or less important role; also, for one priority to become less important than another
dossiers.meaningZh: 退居較次要、不再主導的位置；也可指某件事的重要性讓位於另一件事。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Students’ health should never take a back seat to exam results.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 一般屬於中性至略帶口語色彩的表達，常見於日常對話、工作討論、訪問，以及有關領導、團隊合作和優先次序的一般文章。
dossiers.memoryEn: Moving away from the front represents moving away from the leading or most important position.
dossiers.memoryZh: 從前方移到後方，可以幫助你記住「由主要位置退到次要位置」這個意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse the Idiom with a Literal Seat
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：不要把慣用語與字面座位混淆
semanticRules.en: I sat in the back seat of the taxi. The literal sentence describes where somebody physically sits. It does not describe importance, leadership or responsibility.
semanticRules.zh: 我坐在的士的後座。 我退居次要位置，讓同事帶領討論。 字面句子只說明某人坐在哪裏，並不表示角色、領導權或責任有所改變。

semanticRules.titleEn: Being Quiet Is Not Always “Taking a Back Seat”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：保持安靜不一定等於 take a back seat
semanticRules.en: This does not show that Lily was allowing another person to lead or accepting a smaller role.
semanticRules.zh: 資料不足：

candidateQuestions.promptEn: I decided not to lead the meeting because Priya had more experience.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 我決定不主持會議，因為 Priya 的經驗較豐富。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: I decided to take a back seat and let Priya lead the meeting.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 我決定退居次要位置，讓 Priya 主持會議。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The school play was meant to show the students’ work, so the teachers stayed out of the centre of attention.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 學校話劇旨在展示學生的成果，所以老師沒有成為眾人注意的焦點。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The teachers took a back seat so that the students could be the centre of attention in the school play.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 老師退居次要位置，讓學生在學校話劇中成為焦點。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: After the baby was born, the couple gave family needs a higher priority than travel.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 孩子出生後，這對夫婦把家庭需要放在比旅行更重要的位置。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: After the baby was born, travel took a back seat to the family’s needs.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 孩子出生後，旅行退居次要位置，家庭需要變得更重要。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The chef designed the menu, but on opening night she let her team serve the guests without directing every move.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 廚師設計了餐單，但在開業當晚，她讓團隊接待客人，沒有指揮每一個行動。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The chef designed the menu, but on opening night she took a back seat and let her team serve the guests.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 廚師設計了餐單，但在開業當晚退居次要位置，讓團隊接待客人。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Leah said that once the new leader was ready, she would stop taking the main role.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: Leah 表示，新領袖準備好後，她便不再擔當主要角色。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Leah said that she would take a back seat once the new leader was ready.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: Leah 表示，新領袖準備好後，她便會退居次要位置。

dossiers.meaningEn: A relationship, exchange or situation in which both sides must contribute, communicate, cooperate or accept responsibility.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一段需要雙方付出、溝通、合作或承擔責任的關係或情況；不能只依靠其中一方。
dossiers.registerContextEn: everyday conversations; workplace discussions; school settings; interviews; presentations; advice; newspaper and general-interest writing; discussions about relationships and responsibility.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達可以顯得友善而合理，但有時也帶有輕微的糾正語氣：
dossiers.memoryEn: Traffic moves in both directions; effort and communication should also move in both directions.
dossiers.memoryZh: 交通向兩個方向流動；努力和溝通也應該在雙方之間流動。

semanticRules.titleEn: There Must Be Genuine Mutual Action
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四：情境必須涉及真正的雙向互動
semanticRules.en: The presence of two people does not automatically create a reciprocal relationship.
semanticRules.zh: 兩位朋友互相聆聽和支持。 友誼需要雙方共同維繫。 兩個人同時出現，並不代表他們正在進行雙向互動。

semanticRules.titleEn: It Does Not Mean “Two Choices”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五：它不表示「兩個選擇」
semanticRules.en: The speaker has two choices, but there is no mutual exchange between two sides.
semanticRules.zh: 說話者雖然有兩個選擇，但雙方之間並不存在互相付出或交流。

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid Accidental Literal Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則六：避免意外使用字面意思
semanticRules.en: Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
semanticRules.zh: 這是一條雙程行車道路，因此車輛可以向任何一個方向行駛。 良好溝通需要雙方共同參與。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：自然使用，不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: 1. two sides are involved; 2. both sides have a role or responsibility; 3. one side cannot reasonably expect everything from the other; 4. some form of mutual effort, communication or support is needed. A plain expression may be clearer when no reciprocal relationship is involved.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語最適合用於以下情況： 如果情況並不涉及雙向關係，使用一般表達可能會更加清楚。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A healthy relationship needs care and effort from both partners.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 一段健康的關係需要雙方的關心和努力。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: A healthy relationship is a two-way street.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 健康的關係需要雙方共同經營。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Nora says workers should keep their promises to the company, and the company should keep its promises to workers.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 諾拉表示，員工應該信守對公司的承諾，公司也應信守對員工的承諾。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Nora believes loyalty at work is a two-way street.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 諾拉認為，職場上的忠誠需要雙方共同維持。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The club members told the leader what they needed, and the leader regularly shared important information with them.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 會內成員向領袖說明自己的需要，而領袖也定期與他們分享重要資料。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Communication in the club was a two-way street.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 會內的溝通是雙向的。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Ethan wanted his sister to apologise after their argument, but he refused to admit his own mistake.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 伊頓在爭執後希望妹妹道歉，但他拒絕承認自己的錯誤。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Making peace after an argument is a two-way street.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 爭執後修補關係需要雙方共同努力。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Our teacher wants us to take part, but should she listen to our ideas too? B: Of course.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：老師希望我們投入參與，但她也應該聆聽我們的想法嗎？ 乙：當然應該。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Yes. Good teaching is a two-way street.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 是的。良好的教學需要師生雙方共同參與。

dossiers.meaningEn: Something very unpleasant, disappointing or painful that a person has little choice but to accept.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一件令人非常難受、失望或受挫，卻又不得不接受的事實、結果、決定或處境。
dossiers.registerContextEn: For this worksheet, treat the expression as neutral to slightly informal. It is suitable for conversation, interviews, journalism, workplace discussion and general writing. Its tone commonly conveys disappointment, reluctant acceptance, hurt pride, frustration or sympathy.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 本練習把這個表達視為中性至略帶口語色彩，適合用於日常對話、訪問、新聞、職場討論及一般文章。 它通常帶有失望、無奈接受、自尊受挫、沮喪或同情的語氣。
dossiers.memoryEn: A bitter pill hurts the mouth but still has to be swallowed; a bitter reality hurts emotionally but still has to be accepted.
dossiers.memoryZh: 苦藥令人難受，卻仍要吞下；苦澀的現實令人痛苦，卻仍要接受。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use it for acceptance, not merely difficulty
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：它的重點是「接受」，不只是「困難」
semanticRules.en: Use it for acceptance, not merely difficulty. The situation should involve an unpleasant fact, result, decision or reality that someone must face or accept.
semanticRules.zh: 它的重點是「接受」，不只是「困難」。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use for + person / group to name who must accept it
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五：使用 for + 人/群體，指出誰必須接受這件事
semanticRules.en: Use for + person / group to name who must accept it. The closure was a bitter pill for the staff to swallow.
semanticRules.zh: 使用 for + 人/群體，指出誰必須接受這件事。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not use the idiom literally for medicine
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要把本課慣用語當作真正藥丸的字面描述
semanticRules.en: Do not use the idiom literally for medicine. The patient swallowed a bitter pill describes a real pill unless the wider context clearly establishes a figurative meaning. The patient swallowed a bitter pill
semanticRules.zh: 不要把本課慣用語當作真正藥丸的字面描述。 若沒有比喻語境，只是在描述病人吞下一粒苦味藥丸。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do not use it merely to mean “hard to believe”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：不要把它純粹理解為「難以相信」
semanticRules.en: Do not use it merely to mean “hard to believe”. The central idea is reluctant acceptance of something unpleasant, not simply doubt about whether it is true.
semanticRules.zh: 不要把它純粹理解為「難以相信」。

semanticRules.titleEn: Related variants are natural English, but they are not this exercise’s target
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九
semanticRules.en: Related variants are natural English, but they are not this exercise’s target.
semanticRules.zh: 規則九

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Owen lost the class election and found the result very difficult to accept.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 奧雲在班會選舉中落敗，覺得這個結果很難接受。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Losing the class election was a bitter pill for Owen to swallow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 在班會選舉中落敗，對奧雲而言是難以接受的苦果。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Marcus had insisted that his plan was best, but the results showed that the other plan worked better. He did not enjoy admitting this.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 馬卡斯一直堅稱自己的計劃最好，但結果顯示另一個計劃成效更佳。他很不情願承認這一點。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Admitting that the other plan was better was a bitter pill for Marcus to swallow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 承認另一個計劃更好，對馬卡斯而言是難以接受的事實。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Daniel discovered that he had blamed the wrong person. Accepting his own mistake was embarrassing and unpleasant.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 丹尼爾發現自己怪錯了人。承認自己的錯誤令他既尷尬又難受。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Realising that he had blamed the wrong person was a bitter pill for Daniel to swallow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 意識到自己怪錯了人，對丹尼爾而言是難以接受的事實。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Sofia had looked forward to the final concert for months, but she became ill and had to miss it. She found that deeply disappointing.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 蘇菲亞期待了最後一場音樂會數月，卻因生病而無法出席。她對此感到非常失望。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: For Sofia, having to miss the final concert because she was ill was a bitter pill to swallow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 對蘇菲亞而言，因生病而無法出席最後一場音樂會，是難以接受的遺憾。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The new rule treats every player equally, but some players still find it unpleasant to accept.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 新規則平等對待每名球員，但部分球員仍然覺得很難接受。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Although the new rule is fair, it is still a bitter pill for some players to swallow.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 雖然新規則公平，但對部分球員而言仍然是難以接受的安排。

dossiers.meaningEn: A blank cheque means extremely broad or unlimited permission, authority or financial freedom to do something without needing further approval.
dossiers.meaningZh: 「a blank cheque」 表示給予某人非常廣泛、甚至不受限制的權力、許可或開支自由，讓對方毋須再次取得批准便可行事。
dossiers.registerContextEn: workplace discussions; business communication; journalism; public affairs; discussions about contracts, budgets and authority; ordinary conversation about trust and responsibility.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個表達屬中性至略帶正式，常見於工作討論、商業溝通、新聞報道、公共事務，以及有關合約、 預算、權力、信任和責任的對話。
dossiers.memoryEn: No amount written means no clear financial limit; figuratively, a blank cheque means no clear limit on someone’s freedom or authority.
dossiers.memoryZh: 沒有填寫金額，便沒有清楚的開支上限；在比喻用法中，「a blank cheque」就是某人的自由或權力沒有明確限制。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Only for Very Broad Freedom
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則二：只用於非常廣泛的自由或權力
semanticRules.en: The manager may make every decision and spend whatever is necessary. The manager may spend up to $500 on office paper.
semanticRules.zh: 不適合： 第二個情況已有明確金額上限，並非真正的「a blank cheque」。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Literal and Figurative Uses
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要混淆字面及比喻用法
semanticRules.en: Literal: Figurative:
semanticRules.zh: 主管簽署了一張支票，但沒有填寫金額。 主管讓經理全權管理項目。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Overuse It
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：不要過度使用
semanticRules.en: If the permission is narrow, ordinary expressions such as permission, freedom, approval or a budget may be clearer.
semanticRules.zh: 只有在權力、許可或開支自由極為廣泛時，才應使用這個慣用語。 若權限有限，直接使用 permission、freedom、approval 或 budget 可能更準確。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The company told Daniel to spend whatever was needed to repair the computer system, without asking for further approval.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 公司告訴丹尼爾可按需要花費任何金額維修電腦系統，毋須再作申請。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The company gave Daniel a blank cheque to repair the computer system.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 公司全權授權丹尼爾維修電腦系統，所需開支不設上限。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: I thought the agent could act for us. B: Yes, but we did not allow him to accept any offer he liked.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：我以為代理人可以代表我們行事。 乙：可以，但我們沒有准許他隨意接受任何出價。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Yes, but we did not give the agent a blank cheque to accept any offer.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 可以，但我們沒有讓代理人全權接受任何出價。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Why are the residents angry about the new rule? B: They think it allows the mayor to decide every part of the town's building plans alone.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：為甚麼居民對新規則感到憤怒？ 乙：他們認為新規則容許市長獨自決定市鎮建築規劃的每個部分。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: They think the new rule gives the mayor a blank cheque to control local building plans.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 他們認為新規則讓市長全權控制本地建築規劃。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The team may choose the colour and music, but the client must approve the final design and cost.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 團隊可以選擇顏色和音樂，但最終設計和費用必須由客戶批准。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The client has given the team freedom, but not a blank cheque for the event design.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 客戶給予團隊一定自由，但並沒有讓他們全權決定活動設計及開支。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The parents asked the school to explain the spending rules. They did not want the head teacher to use the whole school fund without checks.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 家長要求學校解釋開支規則。他們不希望校長在沒有監管的情況下使用整筆學校基金。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The parents did not want to give the head teacher a blank cheque to spend the school fund.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 家長不希望讓校長全權動用學校基金。

dossiers.meaningEn: a person whom a family or group regards as troublesome, shameful or different from its other members
dossiers.meaningZh: 被家族或群體視為惹麻煩、令其難堪或與其他成員格格不入的人。
dossiers.registerZh: 通常帶負面評價；須交代評價者
dossiers.registerContextEn: In careful communication, reporting frames such as is regarded as, is seen as or is unfairly treated as make it clear whose judgement is being described.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 這個慣用語通常帶有負面和批判意味。 直接稱某人為 a black sheep，可能會顯得相當尖銳。
dossiers.memoryEn: One unusual sheep stands out in the flock; one disapproved member stands out in the group.
dossiers.memoryZh: 一隻與眾不同的羊在羊群中格外顯眼；一名不獲認同的成員也會在群體中被挑出來。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use it for a person within a group
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三
semanticRules.en: a family; a team; a club; a class; a workplace; an organisation; another recognisable social group.
semanticRules.zh: 這個表達通常指某個家族、團隊、俱樂部、班別、工作場所或機構中的一名成員。

semanticRules.titleEn: It does not simply mean “different”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四
semanticRules.en: Being quiet, choosing an unusual career, dressing differently or holding a different opinion does not automatically make someone a black sheep.
semanticRules.zh: 沉默寡言、選擇不常見的職業、衣着與別不同或持有不同意見，並不會自動令一個人成為 a black sheep。

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid literal animal contexts
semanticRules.titleZh: 第一句只是在描述羊的顏色，並不是本課教授的比喻意思
semanticRules.en: Idiomatic: The dishonest member is regarded as a black sheep in the club.
semanticRules.zh: 第一句只是在描述羊的顏色，並不是本課教授的比喻意思。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Daniel’s relatives are ashamed of him because he has repeatedly stolen money from the family.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 丹尼爾多次偷取家人的金錢，因此親人都以他為恥。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Daniel is regarded as a black sheep in his family because he has repeatedly stolen money from them.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 丹尼爾多次偷取家人的金錢，因此被視為家中令人蒙羞的一員。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The coach said Ben’s repeated cheating had made the whole team look bad.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 教練表示，本多次作弊，令整支球隊的形象受損。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The coach described Ben as a black sheep in the team because of his repeated cheating.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 教練因本多次作弊，而形容他是球隊中的害群之馬。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Priya has broken the club’s rules many times, and the other members now see her as a disgrace.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 普麗雅多次違反俱樂部規則，其他成員現在都視她為團體的恥辱。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Priya has become a black sheep in the club after breaking its rules many times.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 普麗雅多次違反俱樂部規則，因而成為團體中令人蒙羞的一員。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The new student dresses differently, but she has not harmed the group or embarrassed anyone.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這名新生的衣着與別不同，但她沒有傷害團體，也沒有令任何人難堪。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The new student should not be treated as a black sheep merely because she dresses differently.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這名新生不應只因衣着與別不同，便被當成團體中不受接納的人。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Everyone at the shop is honest except one worker who steals from customers.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 店內所有員工都很誠實，只有一名員工會偷取顧客的財物。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: That worker is regarded as a black sheep by the other shop workers because he steals from customers.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 那名員工偷取顧客的財物，因此被其他店員視為害群之馬。

dossiers.editorialCaution: “Black sheep” reports a group judgement; the person may merely be different. Do not present the label as an objective moral verdict.

dossiers.meaningEn: To fail, be defeated, stop working, or come to an unsuccessful end.
dossiers.meaningZh: 失敗；遭到淘汰；停止運作；以失敗告終。
dossiers.registerContextEn: 語域及語氣 Bite the dust is an informal and vivid expression. It is common in conversation, journalism, sports commentary, entertainment and relaxed workplace discussion. It can carry a dramatic, humorous or slightly unsympathetic tone.
dossiers.registerContextZh: Bite the dust 是一個非正式而且形象鮮明的表達。 它常見於日常對話、新聞報道、體育評論、娛樂內容及較輕鬆的工作討論。
dossiers.memoryEn: When something falls all the way into the dust, it has been completely defeated or has completely failed.
dossiers.memoryZh: 當某人或某事物徹底倒在塵土中，便可以聯想到它已完全落敗或失敗。

semanticRules.titleEn: Let the Idiom Replace the Failure Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五：讓慣用語取代失敗意思
semanticRules.en: The second part repeats the meaning of the idiom. The reason remains, but the failure meaning appears only once.
semanticRules.zh: 不要在使用慣用語後，再以 failed completely 重複相同意思。 銀行拒絕貸款後，計劃便宣告失敗。 原因獲得保留，但失敗意思只表達一次。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It Only for a Real or Expected Failure
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：只用於真正或預期的失敗
semanticRules.en: The second sentence gives no evidence of failure.
semanticRules.zh: 項目的資金耗盡後便宣告失敗。 第二句只說明項目開始，沒有證據顯示它失敗。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Failure with a Small Problem
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把小問題當作徹底失敗
semanticRules.en: A slow computer has not necessarily stopped working. The computer stopped working completely and could not be repaired.
semanticRules.zh: 電腦短暫變慢，並不表示它已經報銷。 電腦完全停止運作，而且無法修理。

semanticRules.titleEn: Be Careful with Actual Death
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：小心處理真實死亡
semanticRules.en: cold; humorous; disrespectful; violent; insensitive. The death meaning is not permitted in this exercise.
semanticRules.zh: 這個表達可以表示死亡，但可能顯得冷漠、幽默化、不尊重、暴力或缺乏同理心。 本練習不接受死亡意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Avoid Accidental Literal Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十一：避免意外產生字面意思
semanticRules.en: Only the second sentence contains the target idiom.
semanticRules.zh: 孩子把泥土放進口中，用牙齒咬着塵土。 孩子的玩具車跌下樓梯後便報銷了。 只有第二句使用了本課的目標慣用語。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Everywhere
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十二：不要在所有失敗情境中使用
semanticRules.en: the document is highly formal; the topic is serious or sensitive; the precise type of failure matters; the reader may not understand informal idioms; a neutral tone is required.
semanticRules.zh: 在高度正式、嚴肅、敏感或需要準確說明失敗類型的情況下，直接使用 fail、close、stop working 或 be defeated 可能更加合適。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Our plan to hold the event in the school hall failed when water came through the roof.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 學校禮堂漏水後，我們在禮堂舉行活動的計劃便失敗了。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Our plan to hold the event in the school hall bit the dust when water came through the roof.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 學校禮堂漏水後，我們在禮堂舉行活動的計劃便宣告失敗。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: They repaired the old washing machine three times, but it finally stopped working completely.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 他們曾三次修理那部舊洗衣機，但它最終仍完全停止運作。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The old washing machine finally bit the dust after being repaired three times.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 那部舊洗衣機經過三次維修後，最終仍完全報銷。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The team was defeated after its best player was injured.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 隊中最出色的球員受傷後，球隊便落敗了。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The team bit the dust after its best player was injured.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 隊中最出色的球員受傷後，球隊便落敗了。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The café closed after six months because it had too few customers.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 咖啡店因為顧客太少，開業六個月後便倒閉了。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The café bit the dust after six months because it had too few customers.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 咖啡店因為顧客太少，開業六個月後便倒閉了。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: All the small shops in the street are still open.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 街上的小店暫時仍然全部營業。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: None of the small shops in the street has bitten the dust yet.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 街上的小店暫時仍未有任何一間倒閉。

dossiers.meaningEn: A very high price, a very large payment, or the highest amount that somebody is willing to pay for a product, service, skill or other valuable thing.
dossiers.meaningZh: 為某件產品、服務、專業技能或其他有價值的事物支付的高昂價錢、優厚報酬，或市場願意支付的最高價。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Register: Informal to neutral Typical use: Conversation, business discussions, property sales, recruitment, marketing, auctions, reviews and general professional communication
dossiers.registerContextZh: 語域：非正式至中性常見場合：日常對話、商業討論、物業買賣、招聘、市場推廣、拍賣、評論及一般專業溝通
dossiers.memoryEn: Use the source meaning and examples as the memory link.
dossiers.memoryZh: 以原檔的核心意思及例句作為記憶提示。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use it for a genuinely high price or payment
semanticRules.titleZh: 應該形容在相關市場或語境中明顯屬於高水平的價錢或報酬
semanticRules.en: Top dollar should describe a price or payment that is notably high in the relevant situation. Unless the ticket was unusually expensive, the expression would sound exaggerated.
semanticRules.zh: 應該形容在相關市場或語境中明顯屬於高水平的價錢或報酬。 較弱的用法：

semanticRules.titleEn: For must introduce the product, service or quality being purchased
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五
semanticRules.en: They paid top dollar to the consultant’s advice.
semanticRules.zh: 在 pay top dollar for something 這個句式中，for 後面接所購買的產品、服務或專業能力。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The collector paid a very high price for the rare watch.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 那位收藏家以非常高昂的價錢購入了那枚稀有手錶。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The collector paid top dollar for the rare watch.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 那位收藏家以高價購入了那枚稀有手錶。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Why is this bag so expensive? B: The shop charges a premium because every bag is made by hand.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: A：為甚麼這個袋這麼昂貴？ B：店舖收取高價，因為每個袋都是人手製作的。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The shop charges top dollar because every bag is made by hand.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這間店舖收取高昂價錢，因為每個袋都是人手製作的。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Hotels near the stadium can charge their highest prices when an international final is being held.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 舉行國際決賽時，體育館附近的酒店可以收取最高房價。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Hotels near the stadium can charge top dollar when an international final is being held.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 舉行國際決賽時，體育館附近的酒店可以收取極高房價。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The seller collected all the service records and had the car professionally cleaned. These steps helped him secure the best possible price.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 賣家收集了所有維修記錄，並安排專業清潔汽車。這些措施幫助他取得最佳售價。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The seller collected all the service records and had the car professionally cleaned so that he could get top dollar for it.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 賣家收集所有維修記錄，並安排專業清潔汽車，以便取得最佳售價。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: Are technology firms offering unusually high salaries to attract experienced programmers? B: Yes. There are not enough qualified candidates.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: A：科技公司是否正提供異常優厚的薪酬，以吸引資深程式設計師？ B：是，因為合資格的求職者不足。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Yes, technology firms are paying top dollar to attract experienced programmers.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 是，科技公司正提供優厚薪酬，以吸引資深程式設計師。

dossiers.meaningEn: A plan, system, organisation, argument or situation that appears complete or successful but is actually very weak and could easily fail if one part goes wrong.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一個表面上看似完整或成功，實際上卻十分脆弱的計劃、系統、組織、論點或情況；其中一個部分一旦出錯，整體便可能迅速瓦解。
dossiers.registerContextEn: For teaching purposes, a house of cards is best treated as a neutral-to-informal figurative expression with a strongly critical or warning tone.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 在教學上，a house of cards 可視為中性至非正式的比喻表達，通常帶有明顯的批評或警告語氣。
dossiers.memoryEn: One weak card can bring down the whole house; one weak part can bring down the whole system.
dossiers.memoryZh: 一張不穩的紙牌可以令整座紙牌屋倒下；一個薄弱環節也可以令整個系統瓦解。

semanticRules.titleEn: Use It for a Whole Plan, System or Situation
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三：用來描述整體計劃、系統或情況
semanticRules.en: a business; an organisation; an argument; a budget; a schedule; a project; an arrangement; a claim. The expression normally evaluates an organised whole, not one small object or isolated action.
semanticRules.zh: 合適的主語包括計劃、系統、生意、組織、論點、預算、時間表、項目、安排或說法。 這個表達通常用來評價一個有多個部分的整體，而不是一件小物件或一次獨立行動。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Weakness Must Be Serious
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四：脆弱程度必須相當嚴重
semanticRules.en: A small imperfection does not normally justify the strength of the idiom.
semanticRules.zh: 一次延遲付款便可能令整個項目停頓。 這個項目極不穩固。 項目有一個串字錯誤。 一個小錯誤通常不足以支持這個慣用語所表達的強烈程度。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Parts Often Depend on One Another
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則五：不同部分通常互相依賴
semanticRules.en: 1. several parts depend on one weak part; 2. one failure would affect everything else; 3. there is no backup plan; 4. success depends on many uncertain conditions; 5. the system only appears stable.
semanticRules.zh: 在以下情況中，這個表達尤其自然：

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Same Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：不要重複相同意思
semanticRules.en: The final words merely explain the idiom again. The reason is preserved, but the meaning of weakness is expressed only once.
semanticRules.zh: 後半句只是再次解釋慣用語的意思。 這個計劃十分脆弱，因為它依賴一個未經測試的想法。 原因得以保留，但「十分脆弱」這個意思只表達一次。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse the Literal and Figurative
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：不要混淆字面和比喻意思
semanticRules.en: Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
semanticRules.zh: 孩子在桌上用紙牌搭了一座小屋。 這盤生意十分脆弱，因為它只依賴一名顧客。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Merely for Something Complicated
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：不能只因事情複雜便使用
semanticRules.en: A complicated plan may still be strong and carefully prepared. The idiom is licensed only when the source shows serious instability or a real danger of wider failure.
semanticRules.zh: 一個複雜的計劃仍然可能十分穩固和周全。 只有當原句顯示嚴重不穩定或整體失敗的真正風險時，才適合使用這個慣用語。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The booking system depends on one old computer. If that computer stops working, the whole system stops.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 預約系統完全依賴一部舊電腦。假如那部電腦停止運作，整個系統便會停下來。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The booking system is a house of cards because it depends on one old computer.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這個預約系統十分脆弱，因為它完全依賴一部舊電腦。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The training plan assumes that every member will attend every lesson.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這個訓練計劃假設每名成員都會出席每一堂課。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The training plan is a house of cards because it assumes perfect attendance.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這個訓練計劃十分脆弱，因為它假設所有人每堂都會出席。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The club has announced a large event, but it has not booked the hall, the food or the music.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 社團已宣布舉辦大型活動，但仍未預訂場地、食物或音樂表演。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The club’s event plan is a house of cards because nothing important has been booked.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 社團的活動計劃十分脆弱，因為所有重要安排都尚未預訂。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The new app looks impressive, but all its information is kept in one file.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這個新應用程式看來令人印象深刻，但所有資料都儲存在同一個檔案內。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The new app looks impressive, but it is a house of cards.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這個新應用程式看來令人印象深刻，但其系統其實十分脆弱。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The online shop is run from one person’s phone, and there is no copy of the records anywhere else.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這間網店完全由一個人的電話管理，所有紀錄也沒有其他副本。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The online shop is a house of cards because one phone holds all its records.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這間網店的運作十分脆弱，因為所有紀錄都只儲存在一部電話內。

dossiers.meaningEn: to stay in power by causing disagreements among people who might otherwise unite and oppose you
dossiers.meaningZh: 透過挑起原本可能團結的人之間的分歧，維持自己的權力或控制
dossiers.registerZh: 帶批評意味；主要見於英式英語
dossiers.registerContextEn: A disapproving expression for power maintained by setting groups against one another.
dossiers.registerContextZh: 帶批評意味，形容掌權者挑起群體之間的分歧，令他們難以聯合反對自己。
dossiers.memoryEn: Use the source meaning and examples as the memory link.
dossiers.memoryZh: 以原檔的核心意思及例句作為記憶提示。

semanticRules.titleEn: Follow the Source Exercise Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 按照原檔練習意思運用
semanticRules.en: Preserve the actor, tense, certainty and important context shown in the source.
semanticRules.zh: 保留原檔題目中的行動者、時態、確定程度及重要情境。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The manager gave the two teams different stories about the new timetable. The teams argued with each other instead of questioning him together.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 經理向兩個團隊提供有關新時間表的不同說法。兩個團隊互相爭執，而沒有共同向他提出質疑。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The manager tried to divide and rule by giving the two teams different stories about the new timetable.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 經理向兩個團隊提供有關新時間表的不同說法，企圖分而治之。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The club refused separate private deals and demanded one open meeting for every member.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 學會拒絕接受分開進行的秘密協議，並要求所有成員共同出席一次公開會議。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The club rejected divide and rule and demanded one open meeting for every member.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 學會拒絕分而治之，並要求所有成員共同出席一次公開會議。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: If the members stopped sharing information, the leader could use their misunderstandings to keep them apart.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 如果成員停止分享資訊，領袖便可以利用他們之間的誤會，使他們保持分裂。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The leader could divide and rule more easily if the members stopped sharing information.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 如果成員停止分享資訊，領袖便可以更容易地分而治之。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Before the staff formed one group, management kept the office and warehouse workers arguing over their bonuses.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 在員工組成一個共同團體前，管理層一直使辦公室及倉庫員工為獎金問題互相爭執。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Before the staff formed one group, management had relied on divide and rule, keeping the office and warehouse workers arguing over their bonuses.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 在員工組成共同團體前，管理層一直使辦公室及倉庫員工為獎金問題爭執，採取分而治之的手段。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The hospital administrator may have told the day team that the night team lost the equipment, while telling the night team the opposite.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 醫院行政人員可能曾告訴日間團隊，是夜間團隊弄失了器材；同時又向夜間團隊作出相反說法。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The hospital administrator may have tried to divide and rule through opposite stories given to the day and night teams.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 醫院行政人員可能曾向日間及夜間團隊提供相反說法，企圖分而治之。

dossiers.editorialCaution: Only an exercise PDF was supplied, with no separate teaching pages. The compact definition was independently repaired; every new guide decision needs direct semantic review.

dossiers.meaningEn: Something that combines some features of two different alternatives and provides an intermediate choice or compromise between them.
dossiers.meaningZh: 一個兼具兩種不同選擇部分特點的中間方案或折衷辦法。
dossiers.registerContextEn: The compromise sense of a halfway house is especially associated with British English. It is neutral and can appear in conversation, journalism, product descriptions, workplace discussions, presentations and general writing.
dossiers.registerContextZh: a halfway house 的「折衷方案」意思尤其常見於英式英語。 它屬於中性表達，可用於日常對話、新聞、產品介紹、工作討論、簡報及一般文章。
dossiers.memoryEn: A traveller’s halfway house stood between two places; a figurative halfway house stands between two choices.
dossiers.memoryZh: 旅客的 halfway house 位於兩個地點之間；比喻上的 halfway house 則位於兩個選擇之間。

semanticRules.titleEn: The Middle Option Must Share Relevant Features
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四：中間方案必須兼具兩者的相關特點
semanticRules.en: The three things have no relevant relationship.
semanticRules.zh: 共享辦公室是在家工作和租用私人辦公室之間的折衷選擇。 這三件事物之間沒有相關關係，因此不能構成自然的中間方案。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “Meet Halfway”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則七：不要與 meet halfway 混淆
semanticRules.en: A noun phrase describing an intermediate arrangement or thing. A verb expression meaning that both sides make concessions. The two expressions are related in meaning but are not grammatically interchangeable.
semanticRules.zh: 描述中間安排或事物的名詞短語。 表示雙方各自讓步的動詞表達。 雙方各自讓步，選擇了一個介乎原有計劃之間的折衷方案。 兩個表達的意思有關，但在文法上不能互相替換。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with a Middle Stage in a
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則八：不要與「過程中的中間階段」混淆
semanticRules.en: Oxford also records a halfway house towards something, meaning a middle point in a process or development. That is a related but separate sense and is not taught in these 50 questions. The change is only a halfway house towards a completely new system.
semanticRules.zh: 亦收錄 a halfway house towards something，表示某個過程或發展中的中間階段。 這是相關但不同的意思，本練習的五十題不會教授這個用法。 本練習不包括：

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with the Residential Meaning
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則九：不要與「中途宿舍」的意思混淆
semanticRules.en: Halfway house also has a separate residential meaning: a place where some people stay temporarily while moving from an institution or treatment setting towards more independent life. This is a different dictionary sense and is excluded from the exercise. When discussing real residents or services, use accurate and respectful language and follow the official name used by the relevant service.
semanticRules.zh: 亦有另一個「中途宿舍」的意思，指某些人在離開院舍或治療環境後、重新獨立生活前暫住的地方。 這是另一個字典意思，不屬於本練習的目標用法。 討論真實的住宿人士或服務時，應使用準確而尊重的語言，並採用相關服務的正式名稱。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Any Random Mixture
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十：不能用來描述任何隨意混合
semanticRules.en: The product combines the size of a small car with some of the space of a family car. The bag contains a book and an apple. Simply containing two unrelated things does not create a halfway house.
semanticRules.zh: 產品結合小型汽車的體積和家庭汽車的部分空間。 袋內有一本書和一個蘋果。 單純包含兩件無關的事物，並不構成 a halfway house。

semanticRules.titleEn: Do Not Assume the Compromise Is
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要假設折衷方案必定理想
semanticRules.en: balance two needs successfully; provide a practical temporary answer; be too weak for either side; avoid making a necessary decision; satisfy nobody completely. The surrounding context determines the evaluation.
semanticRules.zh: a halfway house 可以： 具體評價由上下文決定。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: An electric bicycle is pedalled like a normal bicycle, but its motor gives the rider some of the power of a motorbike.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 電動單車像普通單車一樣以腳踏驅動，但它的摩打亦提供部分電單車的動力。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The electric bicycle is a halfway house between a normal bicycle and a motorbike.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 電動單車是普通單車和電單車之間的中間選擇。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The café is not ready to offer home delivery every day, but it will test the service at weekends instead of rejecting the idea completely.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 咖啡店尚未準備好每天提供送餐服務，但它不會完全拒絕這個想法，而是會在週末試行。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The weekend test will act as a halfway house between rejecting home delivery and offering it every day.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 週末試行送餐服務，是完全拒絕送餐和每天提供送餐之間的中間方案。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The room has one large shared area, but movable screens can create smaller private spaces when needed.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 房間設有一個大型共用空間，但有需要時可以利用活動屏風分隔出較小的私人空間。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The family room is a halfway house between one open space and several completely separate rooms.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這個家庭空間是完全開放式設計和多個完全獨立房間之間的折衷方案。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The teacher believes that ignoring the behaviour would be too weak, but an official punishment would be too severe. She may give the pupil a written warning.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 老師認為完全不處理這種行為太過寬鬆，但正式處分又太嚴厲，因此她可能會向學生發出書面警告。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: A written warning may provide a halfway house between doing nothing and giving the pupil a formal punishment.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 書面警告可以是在完全不處理和正式處分學生之間的折衷方案。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: A: The morning train is cheap but very slow, and the evening train is fast but expensive. B: The afternoon train has a medium price and journey time.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 甲：早上的列車便宜但非常慢，而晚上的列車快捷但昂貴。 乙：下午的列車收費和行車時間都介乎兩者之間。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: The afternoon train is a halfway house between the slow cheap service and the fast expensive one.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 下午的列車是便宜但緩慢的服務和昂貴但快捷的服務之間的中間選擇。

dossiers.meaningEn: To join an activity, trend, movement, cause or popular opinion after it has already become fashionable, successful or widely supported—often because you want to share in its popularity or success.
dossiers.meaningZh: 在某項活動、潮流、運動、主張或意見已經變得流行、成功或廣受支持之後，才加入其中；通常是因為希望分享其人氣、好處或成功。
dossiers.registerContextEn: Register: Informal to neutral Typical use: Conversation, journalism, business commentary, reviews, social media, presentations and general professional discussion
dossiers.registerContextZh: 語域：非正式至中性常見場合：日常對話、新聞評論、商業討論、評論文章、社交媒體、簡報及一般專業討論
dossiers.memoryEn: Use the source meaning and examples as the memory link.
dossiers.memoryZh: 以原檔的核心意思及例句作為記憶提示。

semanticRules.titleEn: The trend should already be popular or successful
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則三
semanticRules.en: The expression normally describes joining after a trend, activity or opinion has gained popularity, support or visible success. She did not jump on the bandwagon because no existing popular trend had yet been established.
semanticRules.zh: 這個慣用語通常形容某項潮流、活動或意見已經獲得人氣、支持或成功之後，某人才加入。 較弱的語境：

semanticRules.titleEn: Joining is not automatically “jumping on the bandwagon”
semanticRules.titleZh: 規則四
semanticRules.en: A person may join an activity because they genuinely believe in it, because they have carefully studied it or because it has finally become practical.; the person wanted the same advantages; the person joined late; the decision was imitative or opportunistic.
semanticRules.zh: 某人加入一項活動，可能是因為真正認同它、仔細研究過它，或條件終於變得可行。 這些情況不一定屬於「跟風」。 語境應顯示人氣、他人的成功、潛在利益、較遲加入或模仿行為影響了決定。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Emma began following the diet only after it became extremely popular online.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 這種飲食方式在網上變得非常流行後，Emma 才開始跟隨。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Emma jumped on the bandwagon after the diet became extremely popular online.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 這種飲食方式在網上變得非常流行後，Emma 才跟風加入。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: The first company’s campaign attracted widespread praise. Several smaller brands soon copied the same approach.
candidateQuestions.promptZh: 第一間公司的宣傳活動獲得廣泛讚賞。數個較小的品牌很快便模仿了相同做法。
candidateQuestions.answerEn: Once the first company’s campaign attracted widespread praise, several smaller brands jumped on the bandwagon.
candidateQuestions.answerZh: 第一間公司的宣傳活動獲得廣泛讚賞後，數個較小的品牌很快便跟風採用相同做法。

candidateQuestions.promptEn: Although the new investment was receiving enormous attention, Mei refused to join merely because other people were doing so.
